{{Top|leg}}
The '''Prototype Experimental Launcher''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]-mounted launcher under development at [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] during the [[Galactic War]]. A serious flaw was introduced in Version 4 of the launcher that caused ammunition to detonate, but Version 4 saw the power cycling issues that had been plaguing the launcher fixed. An attempt to mount the launcher alongside [[Celestial Industries]]' [[Powerhouse engine]] caused a test ship to explode, as interference from the engine played havoc with the launcher.
